subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Attract
solution: The correct answer is: **Repel**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Attract **means to draw something towards oneself. (किसी चीज़ को अपनी ओर आकर्षित करना) • **Example**: *The sweet aroma of fresh flowers can attract bees.* • Marked option **Repel **means to push something away from oneself. (किसी चीज़ को अपने से दूर धकेलना) • **Example**: *The negative charge on the balloon repels the positive charge and causes it to move away from the balloon.* • As a result, Attract and Repel are antonyms of each other. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Entice **means to attract or tempt someone with a desirable offer or promise. (किसी को वांछनीय प्रस्ताव या वादे से आकर्षित या प्रलोभित करना) • **Knock **means to strike a surface with a sharp blow. (किसी सतह पर तेज़ प्रहार करना) • **Influence **means to have an effect on someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु पर प्रभाव डालना) 30:T6d0, The correct answer is: **I could not find it anywhere**.
